title: Registry is extensible
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, 3.2.7.1 Subclaims. HCERT Specification, 3.2.7.1 Subclaims: “subclaims for negative integer values are for development purposes and are free to use”.

statements.label: Registry is extensible
statements.requirement: Integrators SHALL be able to register more subclaims and their codecs, and override the defaults, at runtime, without forking the library.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-SEL-002 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-SEL-002 a host registers its own subclaim and issues under it` (SelectPayloadTest.kt)).
